mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_collection_sources ( source_key, source_type, agency_code, agency_name, source_url, enabled ) VALUES ( #{sourceKey}, #{sourceType}, #{agencyCode}, #{agencyName}, #{sourceUrl}, 'Y' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_type = VALUES(source_type), agency_code = VALUES(agency_code), agency_name = VALUES(agency_name), source_url = VALUES(source_url)
mapper.select: SELECT source_id AS sourceId, source_key AS sourceKey, source_type AS sourceType, agency_code AS agencyCode, agency_name AS agencyName, source_url AS sourceUrl, enabled, DATE_FORMAT(last_checked_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastCheckedAt, DATE_FORMAT(last_success_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastSuccessAt, last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage FROM rag_collection_sources ORDER BY agency_code, source_key

INSERT INTO rag_collection_runs (agency_code, status) VALUES (#{agencyCode}, 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_collection_runs SET status = #{status}, discovered_articles = #{discoveredArticles}, new_articles = #{newArticles}, attachments_discovered = #{attachmentsDiscovered}, downloaded_count = #{downloadedCount}, imported_count = #{importedCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, submitted_batches = #{submittedBatches}, last_error_message = #{lastErrorMessage}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId}

SELECT article_id FROM rag_source_articles WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND external_id = #{externalId} LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO rag_source_articles ( source_id, external_id, title, link, published_at, detail_hash, status, fetched_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, #{externalId}, #{title}, #{link}, #{publishedAt}, #{detailHash}, 'DISCOVERED', NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), link = VALUES(link), published_at = VALUES(published_at), detail_hash = VALUES(detail_hash), fetched_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_source_articles SET status = #{status}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, fetched_at = NOW() WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT attachment_id AS attachmentId, article_id AS articleId, url, file_name AS fileName, extension, mime_type AS mimeType, file_hash AS fileHash, local_path AS localPath, document_id AS documentId, status FROM rag_source_attachments WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND url = #{url} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_source_attachments ( article_id, url, file_name, extension, mime_type, file_hash, local_path, document_id, status, last_error_message ) VALUES ( #{articleId}, #{url}, #{fileName}, #{extension}, #{mimeType}, #{fileHash}, #{localPath}, #{documentId}, #{status}, #{errorMessage} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_name = VALUES(file_name), extension = VALUES(extension), mime_type = VALUES(mime_type), file_hash = VALUES(file_hash), local_path = VALUES(local_path), document_id = VALUES(document_id), status = VALUES(status), last_error_message = VALUES(last_error_message)
